sentences.text: The applicant/accused has been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
Therefore, the maximum period of imprisonment that the applicant/accused will have to undergo is for a period of ten years.

2. The learned counsel for the applicant/accused draws my attention to Ext.P2 which is the statement given by PW2, the victim, before the magistrate in which she has admitted that the accused had not raped her.
The father of the victim had given a man-missing complaint on the basis of which the victim was produced before the magistrate pursuant to which her statement was recorded.

According to the learned counsel for the applicant/accused, it is clear that the story of rape is an afterthought and a subsequent development and hence a lenient view may be taken and sentence may be suspended.
3. The application is opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
4. Heard both sides.
5. A copy of Ext.P2, which is the statement of the victim, namely, PW2, was handed over to me during the course of arguments.
I was taken through the entire statement in which PW2 has a case that she was forcibly taken by the accused.
However, the trial court has acquitted the accused for the offence punishable under Section 366 IPC.
As far as the offence of rape is concerned, PW2 in Ext.P2 has stated that the accused has not raped her.
In these circumstances, it appears that the applicant/accused has an arguable case.
vi) It is also made clear that if any of the conditions are violated, the bail shall stand cancelled.
